edges.reason: msg.sender is the root untrusted identity returned by _msgSender().
owner() is compared against _msgSender() inside the onlyOwner modifier, so caller identity gates every privileged function.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner from the value returned by _msgSender().
burn() derives the account to burn from _msgSender() and is gated by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner burn() forwards to the internal _burn routine.
exchangeList() onlyOwner check resolves through _msgSender().
exchangeList() forwards caller-controlled addresses and amounts into _exchangeList.
_exchangeList performs an uncapped supply increase, reachable only by the owner.
_exchangeList emits a self-directed Approval event without updating allowances.
The owner can burn an arbitrary amount of the owner balance without any limit.
The token constructor mints the fixed initial supply of 10e32.
The constructor mints the initial supply directly to msg.sender.
BURNXTOKEN constructor calls the internal _mint.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount using SafeMath.add.
_mint credits _balances[account] by amount.
_burn debits _balances[account] through SafeMath.sub.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_exchangeList increases _totalSupply by an unvalidated amount.
_exchangeList credits _balances[exchangeTo] by the unvalidated amount.
transfer() delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the source account.
_transfer mutates _balances for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom moves tokens from an arbitrary sender relying only on the pre-existing allowance.
transferFrom reduces the allowance by calling _approve.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the _allowances mapping.
approve() delegates the write to _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
increaseAllowance recomputes and stores the allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance recomputes and stores the allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the stored allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from the stored allowance.
_transfer invokes the overridable virtual hook _beforeTokenTransfer before balances are updated, an external-override reentrancy surface.
_mint invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before supply and balance updates.
_burn invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before balances are decremented.
_exchangeList invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before crediting supply.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership depends on owner().
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner gate on renounceOwnership depends on owner().
balanceOf reads from the _balances mapping.
allowance reads from the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
approve() grants an allowance on behalf of _msgSender().
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
Caller-supplied amount parameter is forwarded to _burn by burn().
Caller-supplied exchangeTo parameter is forwarded by exchangeList().
Caller-supplied amount parameter is forwarded by exchangeList().
The unvalidated amount reaches the uncapped _exchangeList mint.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transfer().
sender parameter identifies the debit account in transferFrom().
recipient parameter identifies the credit account in transferFrom().
amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
spender parameter flows into approve().
amount parameter flows into approve().
sender parameter flows into _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer.
account parameter is credited by _mint.
amount parameter is added to supply by _mint.
account parameter is debited by _burn.
amount parameter is subtracted from supply by _burn.
exchangeTo parameter is credited by _exchangeList.
amount parameter is minted without limit by _exchangeList.
owner parameter is used as the allowance key in _approve.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in _approve.
amount parameter is stored by _approve.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner by transferOwnership.
The return value of _msgSender() is cached in the local msgSender variable.
The cached msgSender local is assigned to the _owner state variable at deployment.

normalization_plan.reason: The burn amount parameter is a non-core value that only exists to feed the core BURNXTOKEN.burn function; collapse it into the function node.
exchangeTo is a purely local parameter of exchangeList and is absorbed by its core function node.
The exchangeList amount parameter is a non-core value fully determined by the core exchangeList function.
recipient is a parameter only meaningful inside ERC20.transfer, so it merges into that core function.
The transfer amount parameter has no independent semantics and merges into ERC20.transfer.
sender is a parameter consumed exclusively by ERC20.transferFrom and merges into it.
recipient is a parameter consumed exclusively by ERC20.transferFrom and merges into it.
The transferFrom amount parameter merges into the core ERC20.transferFrom function.
spender is a parameter of ERC20.approve only and merges into that core function.
The approve amount parameter merges into the core ERC20.approve function.
sender is an internal parameter of _transfer and merges into the core _transfer function.
recipient is an internal parameter of _transfer and merges into the core _transfer function.
amount is an internal parameter of _transfer and merges into the core _transfer function.
account is a parameter of _mint and merges into the core _mint function.
amount is a parameter of _mint and merges into the core _mint function.
account is a parameter of _burn and merges into the core _burn function.
amount is a parameter of _burn and merges into the core _burn function.
exchangeTo is a parameter of the core _exchangeList mint operation and merges into it.
amount is the untrusted quantity of the _exchangeList mint and merges into that core function.
owner is a parameter of _approve and merges into the core _approve function.
spender is a parameter of _approve and merges into the core _approve function.
amount is a parameter of _approve and merges into the core _approve function.
newOwner is a parameter used solely by transferOwnership and merges into that core function.
The local msgSender variable is just the cached return value of the core Context._msgSender function, so it merges into it.
